records.title: Evolution of CCP & PRC Intelligence Organizations (1927–2019): Teke, PPB, SAD, CID, 2PLA/JSD & MSS 18-Bureau Structure (CCE-C1, CCE-C7)
records.author_org: Peter Mattis & Dr. Matthew Brazil (Chinese Communist Espionage: An Intelligence Primer, Naval Institute Press, 2019)
records.type: Intelligence Organizational History, Bureau Designations & Counterintelligence Archive
records.description: Maps the institutional lineage of CCP intelligence from Zhou Enlai and Gu Shunzhang's Special Services Section (Teke, 1927–35; Three Heroes of the Dragon's Lair), the Political Protection Bureau (PPB, 1931–39; Mo Xiong's Oct 1934 Fifth Encirclement warning), Kang Sheng and Li Kenong's Social Affairs Department (SAD, 1939–49; 1943 Salvation campaign & Dimitrov telegram; Yan Baohang & Ji Chaoding), Li Kenong and Luo Qingchang's Central Investigation Department (CID, 1955–83; 1955 Pan Hannian purge of 800–1,000 officers; 1979 resistance to Deng's diplomatic-cover ban), 2PLA / JSD Intelligence Bureau & SSF (1955–present; CIISS & CFISS), and the Ministry of State Security (MSS, July 1, 1983–present; 4 expansion waves, CSSC, and Bureaus 1–18).
records.use_description: The papers use historical works and organizational records to trace names and changes in political and administrative institutions.

connection_review.finding: Chapter 6 is another chapter of Mattis and Brazil’s same book and contains the institutional cases. It is not independent corroboration of Chapters 1 and 7.

family_placement_review_20261122.reason: Analytical comparison or explicitly mixed originals; preserve its scope rather than infer one publisher from a carrier URL.

records.title: Ministry of Public Security (MPS / 公安部), Baseline Surveillance (Shenfen Zheng, Hukou, Dang'an), Zhima Social Credit & Six Technical Surveillance Methods (CCE-C1, CCE-C7)
records.author_org: Peter Mattis & Dr. Matthew Brazil (2019) / Luo Ruiqing, Xie Fuzhi, Li Zhen, Hua Guofeng & Alibaba/Ant Financial (Shao Xiaofeng)
records.type: Domestic Counterespionage, Police Administration & Technical Surveillance Architecture
records.description: Documents the MPS from Luo Ruiqing (1949–59; 2,070 spy cases in 1950; 700,000 executions in 1950–51; Sept 1958 dismissal of Soviet advisors) and the Cultural Revolution (1968 HQ cut to 126 staff; Oct 1973 death of Minister Li Zhen; crime rate jumping from 24 to 60 per 100,000) to the July 1983 transfer of counterespionage to the MSS, the 610 Office (June 10, 1999), and modern 'baseline surveillance' (ID card, hukou, dang'an, hotel/PSB registration of ~600,000 resident foreigners, Alibaba/Zhima Credit with 2,094 CCP members and MPS veteran CRO Shao Xiaofeng, and 6 intensive MPS/MSS surveillance methods).
records.use_description: The papers cite historical records and secondary scholarship to describe the public security bureaucracy and its institutional evolution.

family_placement_review_20261122.reason: Analytical case collection with multiple originals; a book access URL does not make every component a Naval Institute Press work.
